question: What fulfillment of desires results from bathing in the waters of Kālidhārā?
premises: Bathing in Kālidhārā water is meritorious.
Such merit can grant the fulfillment of desires.
inference: Having bathed in Kālidhārā water, one obtains all desires.
plain_english: Having bathed in the water of Kālidhārā, one would obtain all desires.
